product_rotate.css: @keyframes rotateY360 { 0% { transform: rotateY(0deg); } 100% { transform: rotateY(360deg); } } .product-3d { animation: rotateY360 12s linear infinite; transform-style: preserve-3d; }

countdown_pulse.css: @keyframes pulseDot { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.3; } } .countdown-sep { animation: pulseDot 1s ease-in-out infinite; }

cta_hover.css: .btn-primary { transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .btn-primary:hover { background: #0051D5; transform: translateY(-1px); }

nav_blur.css: nav { backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border-bottom: 1px solid #2A2A2A; }

home.layout: Full-viewport dark hero with rotating 3D product centered, large condensed product name, three spec callouts row, countdown timer and pre-order CTA below.

features.layout: Vertically stacked 100vh feature sections, alternating left/right product image with text column and large differentiator number callout.

specs.layout: Full-width spec table with category headers, two-column rows (label left muted, value right white bold) alternating #1C1C1C and #222222, PDF download link at bottom.

compare.layout: Three-column comparison table with our product highlighted in accent blue column, checkmarks/X marks per row, price-per-feature summary at bottom.

story.layout: Long-form narrative single column with founder letter, full-width workshop photos between paragraphs, team grid, and community supporter count block.
